summary: John's great-grandmother (mother of grandmother Kathryn); a Plymouth clerk, daughter of a New York-born father who died when she was an infant.
bio: Elizabeth M. McAvoy was born 8 Dec 1897 in Plymouth (FS KGQH-JNV), one of ten children of William Richard McAvoy (b. c.1857 New York, d. 4 Nov 1899 Plymouth) and Catherine A. Murphy. Her father died when she was about two; her widowed mother married John H. Jones, and in 1920 Elizabeth lived 'in household of John H Jones'. On 19 Jun 1923 (licence No. 635) she was a clerk, of 214 Vine St, Plymouth, aged 25, born Penna., father William R. (deceased, born N.Y.), mother Kathryn Murphy (Plymouth, born Penna.); she married Frank J. McGuire on 20 Jun 1923 (Rev. P. J. Colligan, Plymouth). Her sister Agnes M. McAvoy married Joseph S. Jones, a brother of Frank's mother Anna C. Jones — so the McGuire, Jones and McAvoy families were tied together twice before Frank and Elizabeth married. After Frank's death in 1958 she married (2) Harold Arnold. She died 5 May 1984 in Altoona and was buried in Hanover Township (FS).
